The composition is the article's microprobe result Mg0.058(1)Fe0.942(1)O. This record represents only the 300 K cubic B1 compression branch. The article's synchrotron Mossbauer observations begin above the diffraction series and do not provide a separate spin-resolved P-V dataset, so no high-spin, low-spin, or mixed-spin EOS is inferred. The lattice metric is normalized to the published fitted conventional-cell V0.

Published B1 parameterization on the Dewaele-2008 ruby scale. V0 is stored on the conventional eight-atom cell basis. K0-prime was constrained by a finite prior and is therefore listed as free, not fixed. No numerical covariance matrix is available.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: article sections 2.1, 3, and 3.1; article Figure 1 and Table 1; official supplement Table S1.
- **Equation:** Article section 3.1 and Table 1: third-order Birch-Murnaghan isothermal EOS; the prose's isolated 'Burch-Murnaghan' spelling is interpreted by the explicit Birch-Murnaghan figure captions and standard equation implemented by MINUTI.
- **V0:** Article Table 1: 9.860(7) A^3/atom, freely fitted; multiplied by eight atoms per conventional B1 cell.
- **K0:** Article section 3.1 and Table 1: K0T=155.3(22) GPa, freely fitted.
- **K0 prime:** Article section 3.1 and Table 1: K0T'=3.79(11), refined with prior 3.8+/-0.3 rather than fixed.
- **Volume basis:** Supplementary Table S1 and both EOS figures label volume as A^3/atom. The B1 rocksalt conventional cell contains four formula units and eight atoms, so V and sigmaV are multiplied by eight without changing K0 or K0\_prime.
- **Reference temperature (K):** The EOS figures identify the isotherm as 300 K.
- **Uncertainties:** Table S1 gives parenthetical pressure and volume errors. Pressure error is the reported difference among ruby determinations before and after diffraction; the source gives no confidence convention for volume or parameter errors.

</details>
